tasks.title: Additive extension of HuntStateMachine phases and session_gate transitions
acceptance_criteria: ngv2.state_machine PHASES is extended to ('source','hunt','triage','verify','poc','detonate','novelty','report','awaiting_submission','submitted','done') with ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS one-step ordered.

ngv2.session_gate.gate_transition evidence-gate dispatch is wired to invoke corresponding pure sibling gates: source->hunt uses qualify(); triage->verify uses compute_confidence()+route_confidence(); detonate->novelty uses classify_novelty()+route_novelty(); novelty->report uses build_submission_package(); report->awaiting_submission uses readiness(); awaiting_submission->submitted uses approve_submission(); submitted->done uses record_submission().
verify->poc->detonate transitions check the PoC build and require semantic_verdict 'confirmed' on the detonation live report.
For detonate transition, marker-spoofing alone must NOT confirm, requiring expected filesystem-signature in the live fs diff.
No network, wall-clock, randomness, real subprocess, or live platform action in any built code; pure and deterministic.

spec.objective: Wire the full autonomous lifecycle FSM by additively extending HuntStateMachine phases, allowed transitions, and gate_transition evidence gates.
functional_requirements: Extend PHASES to ('source','hunt','triage','verify','poc','detonate','novelty','report','awaiting_submission','submitted','done') and ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS to cover one-step ordered transitions.
Wire gate_transition to qualify targets for source->hunt using qualify() from ngv2_source_qualify_gate.

Wire gate_transition to route triage->verify using compute_confidence() and route_confidence() from ngv2_grounding_confidence_gate, admitting CONFIRMED/HIGH, holding MEDIUM for manual review, dropping LOW.
Wire verify->poc->detonate to check PoC build and use semantic_verdict 'confirmed' (requiring exit 0, success marker, and expected filesystem-signature in live fs diff; marker-spoofing alone fails).
Wire detonate->novelty to use classify_novelty() and route_novelty() from ngv2_novelty_gate, only admitting NOVEL.
Wire novelty->report to use build_submission_package() from ngv2_submission_package_builder.
Wire report->awaiting_submission to use readiness() from ngv2_submission_readiness_gate, requiring ready == True.
Wire awaiting_submission->submitted to use approve_submission() from ngv2_human_approval_gate, requiring operator approval.
Wire submitted->done to use record_submission() from ngv2_human_approval_gate, recording the submission record.
spec.interfaces: extends ngv2.state_machine PHASES and ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS, and ngv2.session_gate.gate_transition(phase_from, phase_to, evidence) -> GateResult
edge_cases: Triage -> verify transition on MEDIUM confidence finding returns GateResult(ok=False, error='manual_review') to hold it in manual review.
Detonation gate transition fails if the live report contains the success marker but lacks the expected filesystem-signature in the live fs diff.
Transition from awaiting_submission to submitted fails if approve_submission outcome is 'parked'.
non_goals: Do NOT rewrite or replace the existing HuntStateMachine — extend it additively.
Do NOT re-implement the pure gates (import and call the sibling modules).
Do NOT weaken any existing acceptance gate, especially the strengthened detonation semantic verdict.
Do NOT implement any seam adapter (bounty oracle, scanners, LLM hunt worker, live runner, approval seam) — all injected.
Do not build the SessionApi/MCP surface (that is ngv2_session_api_surface).
No integration tests beyond the wiring's own RED oracle.
spec.implementation_notes:
Modify ngv2/state_machine.py to extend PHASES and ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS. Wire ngv2/session_gate.py gate_transition by importing and invoking qualify, compute_confidence, route_confidence, classify_novelty, route_novelty, build_submission_package, readiness, approve_submission, record_submission, and semantic_verdict. Keep all gates pure, stdlib-only, and deterministic.

# CREDENTIAL-NAMING CONSTRAINT (the AST security gate FAILS the build if a variable whose name contains (case-insensitive) "password", "secret", or "key" is assigned a string literal -- it reads as a hardcoded credential even though this is an external clean-room target with no real secret). NEVER bind a string literal to such a variable. Use a neutral name instead (field_name, check_id, label, name, ident, column) or iterate a collection literal / build the mapping from a list of tuples. This applies to dict keys held in a temp var, field labels, and constant identifiers.

# STDLIB-ONLY CONSTRAINT (the verification environment installs NO third-party packages, so importing one fails collection -> the whole build is rolled back and the leaf is parked). Import ONLY the Python standard library. Import NO third-party package: NO pydantic, NO pydantic_settings, NO attrs, NO pyyaml, NO numpy, NO requests, etc. For data models / config use stdlib dataclasses (dataclasses.dataclass), enum.Enum, typing, and plain dict / json instead of pydantic BaseModel / BaseSettings. If the spec mentions pydantic-style validation, re-express it with stdlib dataclasses + manual checks.

# DETERMINISM CONSTRAINT (the AST nondeterminism gate FAILS the build if it sees a wall-clock or nondeterministic source). Do NOT call datetime.now / datetime.utcnow, time.time / time.monotonic, unseeded random, uuid, os.urandom, or secrets to obtain a timestamp / id / randomness. Instead accept any timestamp, seed, or clock as an EXPLICIT parameter with a deterministic default (the oracle injects it, e.g. via now_fn / make_scripted_clock), so the same inputs always produce the same output.


# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/test_state_machine.py
```python
"""Oracle for ngv2-state-machine (Epic-1 L1, depends on ngv2.contracts).
Pins the hunt->triage->poc->detonate->report->done phase model + serializable
state (with Findings). Imports ngv2.contracts -> exercises the dependency edge.
"""
import pytest

from ngv2.contracts import Finding
from ngv2.state_machine import (
    PHASES,
    ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS,
    HuntState,
    HuntStateMachine,
)


def test_phases_constant():
    assert PHASES == ('hunt', 'triage', 'poc', 'detonate', 'report', 'done')


def test_initial_phase_is_hunt():
    assert HuntStateMachine().state.phase == 'hunt'


def test_legal_transition_advances():
    sm = HuntStateMachine()
    assert sm.can_transition('triage') is True
    sm.transition('triage')
    assert sm.state.phase == 'triage'


def test_illegal_transition_raises_and_preserves_phase():
    sm = HuntStateMachine()  # at 'hunt'
    assert sm.can_transition('report') is False
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        sm.transition('report')
    assert sm.state.phase == 'hunt'


def test_early_done_allowed_from_every_non_terminal_phase():
    for src in ('hunt', 'triage', 'poc', 'detonate', 'report'):
        assert 'done' in ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS[src]


def test_roundtrip_preserves_phase_and_findings():
    sm = HuntStateMachine()
    f = Finding(id='F1', target='t', category='c', severity='high',
                title='ti', description='de', evidence=['e'])
    sm.add_finding(f)
    sm.transition('triage')
    restored = HuntStateMachine.from_dict(sm.to_dict())
    assert restored.state.phase == 'triage'
    assert restored.state.findings == [f]

```
